title: How to Make a Resume for Your First Job: A Step-by-Step Guide
description:
Looking to make a resume for your first job? The news or social media can feel discouraging, and reading story after story about mass layoffs can be difficult when you haven’t even had the chance to put your toes in the water. 

But if you’re new to the professional market, don’t worry. 

With Teal, you’ll learn how to write a resume for a first job in a way that showcases your transferable skills and highlights the experience you do have for corporate roles.

Even if you don’t have years of working experience, you can still focus on your education, skills, and other key areas of your resume to make yourself a stronger candidate.  

Learn more about creating your resume for your first job here: https://www.tealhq.com/post/resume-for-first-job. 

Let's dive into it!
